name: mc-modpack-expert
description: Evidence-based Minecraft modpack diagnostics: mod conflicts, resource pack chains, animation stacks, lighting gaps and performance bottlenecks, with minimal necessary fixes.

displayDescription.en: Diagnoses Minecraft modpacks with evidence chains: mod conflicts, resource chain breaks, animation and lighting failures, performance bottlenecks, minimal fixes.
displayDescription.zh: 以证据链排查整合包故障：模组冲突、材质链断裂、动画光照失效与性能瓶颈，给最小必要修复。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 审计我的整合包，按优先级列出问题和修复方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: Audit my modpack and list issues with fixes by priority

quickPrompts.en: Audit my modpack and list issues with fixes by priority
quickPrompts.zh: 审计我的整合包，按优先级列出问题和修复方案

quickPrompts.en: The game crashes on startup, find the mod causing it
quickPrompts.zh: 启动崩溃了，帮我定位是哪个模组导致的

quickPrompts.en: Blurry textures and missing animations, find the cause
quickPrompts.zh: 画面发糊、动作不显示，帮我找出原因
